title: ChangeSet
description: A parsed data pull-request diff. PRODUCED BY OWNER B (ci/diff), CONSUMED BY OWNER A (core/). This file is the frozen interface between the two halves of the project; see CONTRACT.md before changing anything here. INVARIANT: the only unconstrained free-text string in this schema is untrustedText.value. Every other string is an identifier constrained by pattern, enum or format. Free text is untrusted by construction and must reach a prompt only through core/untrusted.

schema_version.description: Bumped only by a PR approved by both owners.

column_changes.description: One entry per (dataset, column) affected by the diff. Order is the diff order and is not significant.

untrusted_text.description: Pull-request level free text (title, body, review comments). UNTRUSTED.

author.description: GitHub login. An identifier, not free text.

pullRequest.description: PR title and body are deliberately absent: they are free text and belong in untrusted_text.

id.description: Stable within one ChangeSet. Referenced by ImpactReport.column_impacts[].change_id.

dbt_model.description: dbt model name without path or extension, e.g. dim_customers.

dataset_urn.description: DataHub dataset URN of the model's materialised table. Owner A resolves lineage from this.

column.description: For removed/renamed/type_changed this is the BASE-revision column name. For added it is the HEAD-revision name.

old_value.description: renamed: old column name (equal to `column`). type_changed/removed: the base-revision declared type. added: null.

new_value.description: renamed: new column name. type_changed/added: the head-revision declared type. removed: null.

file_path.description: Path of the changed file relative to the data repo root, e.g. models/marts/dim_customers.sql.

line.description: 1-indexed line in the head revision, for deep links.

untrusted_text.description: Every free-text field the diff touched for this column: dbt YAML descriptions, meta blocks, SQL comments. UNTRUSTED: copied verbatim, never sanitised by the extractor.

untrustedText.description: A verbatim copy of free text that originated outside the tool. It may contain instructions aimed at the review agent. See docs/THREAT_MODEL.md.

id.description: Content-addressed: 'ut-' + first 12 hex chars of sha256(value). Used as the nonce in the prompt delimiter, which is why it must be derived from the content and not assigned by the producer.

value.description: VERBATIM. The extractor must not strip, escape, summarise or truncate this. Detection and quarantine happen in core/untrusted, never at extraction time, so that what the agent sees is exactly what a human reviewer would see.

method.description: How the columns were derived. Never 'llm': extraction is deterministic by contract.
